description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling submission-related endpoints in a data insights dashboard system. It includes routes for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, integrating authentication, validation, and business logic via imported services.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router class used to define API endpoints and their metadata.

methods.name: CreateSubmissionResponse create_submission( user=Security(get_current_user_dep), payload: dict = Body(default=None), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new data submission, triggering validation pipeline after authentication.

methods.name: GetSubmissionResponse get_submission( submission_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific submission by ID, including validation status.

methods.name: TriggerValidationResponse trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Initiate validation process for a specific submission, including quality checks.

methods.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Approve or reject a submission with optional electronic signature and risk of conflicts with business rules.
